query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_labelling_checks (
  id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  check_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  label VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  market VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EU/CH',
  is_mandatory TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  checked TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  verified_at BIGINT NULL,
  verified_by VARCHAR(128) NULL,
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_product_check (product_id, tenant_id, check_key)
);
